events.title: Fisher’s Memorial Service
events.description: Join the community for a heartfelt memorial service honouring the fishermen who have lost their lives at sea. This moving ceremony reflects the deep connection between Lunenburg and its fishing heritage. All are welcome to attend and pay their respects.

events.title: Repair Café
events.description: Got items that need fixing? Bring them to the Repair Café. Past cafés have covered small furniture and appliances, tool sharpening, bikes, jewelry, clothes, electronics, computers, and a take-apart table. Volunteer fixers are wanted — any level of experience welcome, contact siriarnet@gmail.com.

events.title: South Shore’s Got Talent
events.description: Take 2! South Shore’s Got Talent, and we want to showcase yours! Bring us your juggling acts, your beat poetry, your song, your dance … you name it! Email shari@oldconfidence.com to sign up!

events.title: Anchors & Axles Car Show We Feed Lunenburg Fundraiser
events.description: Anchors & Axles brings together car enthusiasts and visitors for a showcase of classic and custom vehicles set against the scenic waterfront. Enjoy a relaxed atmosphere, meet fellow enthusiasts, and explore a unique blend of automotive and maritime culture.

events.title: Lunenburg Doc Fest 2026 — 13th Edition
events.description: The 13th edition of the Lunenburg Doc Fest: 5 nights, 60+ documentaries. An examined life is worth viewing. Features, shorts, filmmaker Q&As, workshops, and free community events. Opening gala September 24, 5-7 PM, with food, drinks and a film screening. You don't need a full pass — standalone tickets for individual films can be ordered from the film schedule once it's posted. First-time attendee and student passes are $50.
events.price: Individual film tickets available; Film Pass $85 early bird / $100 (Gala & Film bundle $150/$160; students & first-timers $50)
